title: Centralize and guard perk-owned dot-directory path construction
body:
Closes #891

Plan: #891

<details><summary>Plan #891</summary>

# Centralize perk-owned dot-directory path construction + guard it

Part of Objective #878, Node 1.1.

## Goal & non-goals

**Goal.** Introduce one per-plane seam that owns construction of the four **perk-owned**
dot-directory path families — perk dir, config files, workflow dir, repo-skills dir — route every
ad-hoc production construction through it, and add source-scan guards that fail CI when production
code hand-builds `.pi/workflow`, `.pi/perk.toml`, `.pi/perk.local.toml`, or `.pi/skills` outside the
seam. **No behavior change:** every path resolves to exactly its current `.pi/...` location.

**Why now.** Objective #878 migrates the perk-owned slice of `.pi/` to `.perk/` one family per
phase (config in 2.1, workflow in 3.1, skills in 4.1). This node makes each family redirectable from
**one** seam helper so later phases are a localized edit, and the guard prevents new hard-coded
references from re-accreting between phases.

**Non-goals.** No path *moves* (paths stay `.pi/...`). **Pi-native** paths (`.pi/settings.json`,
`.pi/agents/`, `.pi/npm`, `.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md`, `~/.pi/agent`) are out of scope and stay
hand-constructed at their Pi-native sites — `.pi/` is not generally perk-owned. No user-docs change
(no user-facing behavior changes). No doctor migration logic (that lands with each move phase).

## Safety — this cannot break perk mid-stream (reviewer Q)

This node is a **pure internal refactor with zero on-disk or cross-plane behavior change**, so a
perk that is mid-flight when this lands keeps working:

- **Every helper returns byte-identical paths.** `config_file → root/".pi"/"perk.toml"`,
  `local_config_file → root/".pi"/"perk.local.toml"`, `workflow_dir → root/".pi"/"workflow"`,
  `repo_skills_dir → root/".pi"/"skills"`. No file is moved, renamed, created, or deleted; no config
  is re-read from a new place. A repo's `.pi/...` on-disk layout is untouched. (The `_INBOX_REL`
  reroute resolves to the **identical** `.pi/workflow/scratch/learn-docs-inbox.md` —
  `cache.scratch_dir(root)/"learn-docs-inbox.md"` == `root/".pi"/"workflow"/"scratch"/...`; verified
  by equality, not just intent.)
- **Both planes stay in lockstep.** The Python and TS seams resolve the same `.pi/...` strings, so a
  warm in-session (TS) run and a cold CLI (Python) invocation in the same worktree continue to agree
  on every path — there is no window where the two planes disagree.
- **No run-state / handoff / cache *format* change.** This node touches only path *construction*,
  never the contents/shape of handoff blobs, plan-ref, session-data, or markers. An in-progress
  run's `.pi/workflow/` artifacts remain valid and readable.
- **No public-surface break.** The only symbols that change modules are `CONFIG_FILENAME`/
  `LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME` (now in `paths`) and the two skills constants; every importer in this repo
  is updated in the same change (`init/templates.py`, `init/blocks.py`, the skills commands,
  `init/repo_skills.py`). No external/published API depends on these (perk owns all call sites).
- **Guards are test-only.** The new `test_paths_guard.py` / `pathsGuard.test.ts` run under
  `just ci`; they add no runtime code path and cannot affect a running session.
- **Dogfood-safe.** When this merges into perk-the-repo, the installed perk / loaded extension keeps
  reading and writing `.pi/...` exactly as before; the next plan→implement→submit→land→learn cycle
  is unaffected. The actual `.pi/`→`.perk/` *move* (the only behavior-changing step) is deliberately
  deferred to Phases 2–6, each with its own `doctor --fix` migration.

## Status (today)

- **Python.** `perk/state/cache.py::workflow_dir(root)` already owns `root / ".pi" / "workflow"`
  (guarded for `scratch`/`runs` by `tests/test_cache_guard.py`). Config construction is **not**
  centralized: `perk/substrate/config.py` hand-builds `repo_root / ".pi" / CONFIG_FILENAME` in
  `load_config`, `load_committed_compaction`, `load_committed_issues_backend`,
  `load_committed_issues_team`, and `root / ".pi" / LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME` in
  `load_local_linear_api_key`. `CONFIG_FILENAME`/`LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME` live in `config.py`
  (imported by `convergence/init/templates.py` and `convergence/init/blocks.py`). Repo-skills path is
  **two duplicate constants**: `cli/commands/skills/shared.py::REPO_SKILLS_REL = ".pi/skills"` and
  `convergence/init/repo_skills.py::REPO_SKILLS_DIR = ".pi/skills"`. `convergence/doctor/checks.py`
  hand-builds `pi = root / ".pi"` for the config-presence check.
  `cli/commands/learn/docs_cmd.py::_INBOX_REL = Path(".pi/workflow/scratch/learn-docs-inbox.md")` is
  a flat-string workflow path bypassing the cache seam.
- **TypeScript.** `extension/substrate/cache.ts::workflowDir(cwd)` owns `join(cwd, ".pi", "workflow")`
  (guarded for `scratch`/`runs` by `extension/cacheGuard.test.ts`). `extension/substrate/config.ts`
  hand-builds `join(cwd, ".pi")` / `join(cwd, ".pi", CONFIG_FILENAME)` in `loadPerkConfig` and
  `resolveIssueBackendId`, and defines `CONFIG_FILENAME`/`LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME`. `extension/index.ts`
  hand-builds `join(cwd, ".pi", "workflow")` twice (`writeT3Sentinel`, the selfcheck block).
  `extension/workerMain.ts` interpolates `${parsed.worktree}/.pi/workflow` in an error message.

## Resolved decisions (from grill)

1. **New leaf module per plane** (`perk/substrate/paths.py`, `extension/substrate/paths.ts`) owns
   perk_dir / config / repo-skills construction + the filename constants. **`workflow_dir`/
   `workflowDir` stay in `cache.py`/`cache.ts`** (the established §8.1 cache seam). The new guards
   allowlist both `paths` and `cache`.
2. **Family-scoped construction guard** (not a blanket `.pi` ban): bans only construction of the
   four perk-owned families; Pi-native `.pi/...` stays free; comments/docstrings mentioning
   `.pi/workflow` stay legal (still accurate).
3. **Fold in the guard-forced cleanups**: consolidate the two skills constants into one; route
   `_INBOX_REL` through `cache.scratch_dir`.
4. **`config_dir` is the single redirection point for the config family** (file helpers derive from
   it); each family is independently redirectable (no shared switch couples all families).

## Plan

### 1. Python seam — `perk/substrate/paths.py` (new leaf, pathlib-only; no perk imports)

```python
CONFIG_FILENAME = "perk.toml"
LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME = "perk.local.toml"
REPO_SKILLS_REL = ".pi/skills"   # forward-slash relative string for display f-strings

def perk_dir(root: Path) -> Path:            # perk-owned dot-dir root (shared with Pi today)
    return root / ".pi"
def config_dir(root: Path) -> Path:          # SINGLE config-family redirection point
    return root / ".pi"
def config_file(root: Path) -> Path:
    return config_dir(root) / CONFIG_FILENAME
def local_config_file(root: Path) -> Path:
    return config_dir(root) / LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME
def repo_skills_dir(root: Path) -> Path:     # repo-authored skill source root
    return root / ".pi" / "skills"
```

- Module docstring: this is the sole construction site for perk-owned dot-paths; Objective #878 will
  redirect each family to `.perk/`; Pi-native `.pi/...` is intentionally elsewhere.
- `REPO_SKILLS_REL` and `repo_skills_dir` are kept byte-consistent (same `.pi/skills` literal text).

### 2. Route Python consumers through the seam

- **`config.py`**: import `CONFIG_FILENAME`/`LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME` from `paths`; replace the four
  committed reads with `_read_toml(paths.config_file(repo_root))`; `load_config`'s overlay loop reads
  `paths.config_file`/`paths.local_config_file`; `load_local_linear_api_key` keeps
  `root = git.main_worktree_root(repo_root) or repo_root`, then `paths.local_config_file(root)`.
- **`convergence/init/templates.py`**, **`convergence/init/blocks.py`**: import the filename
  constants from `paths` (not `config`).
- **`convergence/doctor/checks.py`**: the config-presence check reads `paths.config_file(root)` /
  `paths.local_config_file(root)` (replacing `pi = root / ".pi"` + `(pi / n).is_file()`).
- **`cli/commands/skills/shared.py`** + **`convergence/init/repo_skills.py`**: delete the two
  duplicate constants; import `REPO_SKILLS_REL` from `paths` for display f-strings and use
  `paths.repo_skills_dir(root)` for path construction (`root / REPO_SKILLS_REL / skill_name` →
  `paths.repo_skills_dir(root) / skill_name`). All `f"{REPO_SKILLS_REL}/..."` display strings keep
  the imported `REPO_SKILLS_REL`.
- **`cli/commands/learn/docs_cmd.py`**: replace `_INBOX_REL` + `repo_root / _INBOX_REL` with
  `cache.scratch_dir(repo_root) / "learn-docs-inbox.md"` (define a module-level filename constant
  `_INBOX_NAME = "learn-docs-inbox.md"`; both `_gather` and the command site use it).

### 3. TypeScript seam — `extension/substrate/paths.ts` (new; node builtins only)

```ts
export const CONFIG_FILENAME = "perk.toml";
export const LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME = "perk.local.toml";
export function perkDir(cwd: string): string { return join(cwd, ".pi"); }
export function configDir(cwd: string): string { return join(cwd, ".pi"); }      // single point
export function configFile(cwd: string): string { return join(configDir(cwd), CONFIG_FILENAME); }
export function localConfigFile(cwd: string): string { return join(configDir(cwd), LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME); }
```

- **`config.ts`**: import the filename constants + helpers from `paths.ts` (drop the local
  `const CONFIG_FILENAME`/`LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME`); `loadPerkConfig` reads `configFile`/
  `localConfigFile` (overlay loop unchanged); `resolveIssueBackendId` reads `configFile(cwd)`.
- **`index.ts`**: both `join(cwd, ".pi", "workflow")` sites use `workflowDir(cwd)` (imported from
  `cache.ts`).
- **`workerMain.ts`**: the error message interpolates `workflowDir(parsed.worktree)` instead of the
  literal `${parsed.worktree}/.pi/workflow`.

### 4. Guards (operator-adjacency, family-scoped)

- **Python** `tests/test_paths_guard.py` (new): scan `perk/**/*.py`. Banned pattern = a quoted
  `".pi"` segment immediately adjacent to a `/` operator whose other segment is a perk-owned family
  follow-segment: `"workflow"`, `"skills"`, the identifiers `CONFIG_FILENAME`/`LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME`,
  or the literals `"perk.toml"`/`"perk.local.toml"`. Operator-adjacency only (no flat-string/comment
  scanning) so prose mentioning `.pi/workflow` and Pi-native `".pi" / "npm"` / `".pi" / "agents"` /
  `".pi" / "settings.json"` do **not** match. Allowlist: `substrate/paths.py`, `state/cache.py`.
  Tests:
  - source scan over production files (excluding the allowlist) → no offenders;
  - self-checks: file list non-empty + contains `paths.py` and `cache.py`; the combined pattern
    matches the seam (`cache.py` carries `".pi" / "workflow"`, `paths.py` carries `".pi" / "skills"`);
  - per-arm **positive** unit asserts on synthetic strings (`root / ".pi" / "workflow"`,
    `root / ".pi" / CONFIG_FILENAME`, `root / ".pi" / LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME`, `root / ".pi" / "skills"`,
    `root / ".pi" / "perk.toml"`) all match — keeps the config/local arms honest even though the
    seam derives them;
  - **negative** unit asserts that Pi-native `root / ".pi" / "npm"`, `".pi" / "agents"`,
    `".pi" / "settings.json"` do **not** match.
- **TypeScript** `extension/pathsGuard.test.ts` (new): mirror for the config + workflow families
  (skills is Python-only). Reuse `cacheGuard.test.ts`'s recursive-readdir + comment-strip +
  self-check recipe. Banned pattern = `".pi"` adjacent to `"workflow"`/`CONFIG_FILENAME`/
  `LOCAL_CONFIG_FILENAME`/`"perk.toml"`/`"perk.local.toml"`. Allowlist: `substrate/paths.ts`,
  `substrate/cache.ts`. Same self-check + positive/negative (Pi-native `.pi`+`APPEND_SYSTEM.md`/`npm`
  free) unit asserts.
- Existing `scratch`/`runs` guards stay unchanged.

### 5. Contract

- Amend `shared/contracts.md` §8.1: add a short note that perk-owned dot-path construction is
  confined to the per-plane `paths` seam (+ `cache.workflow_dir`/`workflowDir` for the workflow
  family), guard-tested in both planes (`tests/test_paths_guard.py`, `extension/pathsGuard.test.ts`);
  Pi-native `.pi/...` is explicitly not perk-owned. No path values change.

## Verification

- `just ci` green (ruff, ty, Biome, tsc, pytest, node:test).
- Plant/revert self-check: a planted `.pi/workflow` / `.pi/perk.toml` / `.pi/skills` construction in
  a production file fails the new guard; removing it passes.
- Existing config/cache/skills/init/doctor suites (`tests/test_config.py`, `tests/test_cache.py`,
  `tests/test_repo_skills.py`, `tests/test_skills_cmd.py`, plus TS `config.test.ts`, `cache.test.ts`)
  stay green — confirming no behavior change.
- Grep proof: no production construction of the four families outside `paths`/`cache`.

## Exit criteria

- One seam change (`config_dir` / `workflow_dir` / `repo_skills_dir`, or `perk_dir`) redirects each
  path family; no call site changes when a family moves.
- The guards catch new direct references to the four families in production code.
- Every path still resolves to its current `.pi/...` location (no behavior change).

</details>
